title: This startup’s self-driving excavators help dig up $600M in new funding
displayTitle: Bedrock Robotics获6亿美元C轮，自动挖掘机进入工地运营
summary: TechCrunch报道，Bedrock Robotics完成6亿美元C轮融资，估值41亿美元，由CapitalG和Emergence Capital共同领投。其改装套件已在内华达和得州工地商业运营，但规模、利用率仍待观察。
investorNote: 重型设备自动化从试点进入实际工地是重要信号，规模化回报取决于项目周期和安全责任。
narrative: Bedrock Robotics完成6亿美元C轮，报道估值41亿美元。公司的自动驾驶改装套件已装到挖掘机上，在内华达水处理工程和得州土方项目商业运营；这比单纯展示机器人视频更接近可收费的场景。融资规模反映资本对施工劳动力缺口的押注，不过工地差异、设备停机率和安全责任尚无法从融资新闻里判断。

evidence.quote: Bedrock Robotics has raised $600 million in a funding round that values the autonomous vehicle technology startup at $4.1 billion, marking a speedy ascent for the two-year-old company.

Bedrock Robotics has developed a self-driving kit that can be retrofitted onto construction and other worksite vehicles. Excavators outfitted with Bedrock’s autonomous-driving tech are now commercially operating at a Nevada-based water treatment facility, an earthwork site run by Champion Site Prep in Texas
